title: free-for-creators category file
description: Schema for data/<slug>.json. Editor aid — authoritative validation lives in scripts/build_readme.py.

category.description: Human-readable category name, used as the README heading.

category_zh.description: Chinese category name, used as the README.zh-CN.md heading.

description_zh.description: Chinese one-line description of the category.

url.description: Canonical landing page. HTTPS only, no affiliate or tracking params, no URL shorteners.

description.description: What it is, in one line. No pipe characters.

description_zh.description: Chinese description. Optional, and deliberately not in the required list above: an entry without one renders in English on the Chinese page, and check_entry.py prints a warning rather than failing the build. Native wording still beats machine translation, so contributors are encouraged to supply it.

license.description: License name as the source states it, e.g. 'CC0', 'Pixabay Content License', 'Various (per item)'. Free text — for filtering use license_family.

license_family.description: Controlled class of the license, used for stats and the site's CC0 filter. cc0 = CC0/public domain only, no conditions. permissive = OSS licenses (MIT/Apache/OFL/ISC/UFL). cc-by = Creative Commons attribution/share-alike. site-free = the site's own free license (attribution column says whether credit is needed). mixed = terms differ per item, or are not uniformly known. noncommercial = not free for commercial/monetized use.

contains_cc0.description: Only with license_family 'mixed': the site does host CC0/public-domain items, but they must be filtered per asset. Set true so the CC0 filter still surfaces it.

attribution.description: Is credit/attribution mandatory for free use?

monetization.description: Can it be used in monetized/commercial content for free?

signup.description: Is an account needed to download?

notes.description: Optional caveats shown in italics after the description. Bounded so a note stays a caveat rather than becoming a terms-of-service digest; the longest in the data is 174.

notes_zh.description: Chinese caveats. Optional — the zh README falls back to English.

submitted_by.description: GitHub username of the person who suggested this entry. Rendered as a credit under Contributors and beside the entry.

skip_linkcheck.description: Set true only when CI cannot check the URL (e.g. login walls). Justify in the PR.

linkcheck_js.description: Set true when the page is a JavaScript app whose HTML contains no <title>/<h1>, so scripts/linkcheck.py cannot confirm content from a plain fetch and would otherwise report it as needing a manual check. The URL is still checked for status, redirects and soft-404s.

license_checked.description: YYYY-MM-DD this entry's licence wording was last read at its source. The weekly link check proves a URL resolves; only a human reading the page proves the licence still says what the entry claims. Optional because the entries that predate the field have no honest date to carry — scripts/check_entry.py --license-audit lists them as a backlog.

license_source.description: The page the licence wording was read at — the site's terms page, or a repository LICENSE file. Required whenever license_checked is set, so every date can be traced back to what was read.
